title: You Coulda Knocked Me Over With a Feather will never not make me cry ...
transcript: I've been really depressed and I realise it's because I haven't seen a piece of theatre in over a week so I bought tickets to a show this morning also I really need to cut my bangs alright let's go hello Denver Center it's been a while you know we know it's not a perfect show there's a lot of criticisms about I'm like a hot but at the end of the day it put a smile on my face and there was a crowded theater in the middle of America cheering for a person coming out as gender fluid or trans or non binary we're still not sure again the representation could be better but people were cheering for Daphne as a character today it just it reminds me that there are people who can show empathy and understanding and love and wanna see people just be themselves everywhere in this country also Leandra Ellis-Gaston Gaston Gaston absolute star as sugar oh my gosh the vocals I mean really I always say it is harder to sing any score in Denver than anywhere else in the country and the vocals were fire anyway depression solved this is exactly what I needed it's not a perfect show but it's what I needed today so you know thank you thank you Cast of some like a hot if you're in Denver and you just want a silly good time go see some like a hot it's here until the 20th of July
